comment: The previous entry said the sample is not resampled and plays at the wrong pitch when it was recorded at another rate. The loader in 2.1.1 (waves::getMonoWav in src/dep/waves.cpp) runs a SampleRateConverter whenever the file's rate differs from the engine's, so that claim was dropped. The gate input is tested for a cable but the voltage read for it comes from the speed input: POUPRE.cpp:250 reads SPEED_INPUT inside the branch guarded by GATE_INPUT.isConnected.
